name: @equin/plugin-framework-tooling-web-artifacts
description: Per-plugin web build artifacts: content-addressed vite lib-mode builds composed via an import map

holds.reason: Babel 8 is the Babel half of the build-pipeline move held for @vitejs/plugin-react 6 (task-1793076072-gwttlf), not a drop-in. Checked 2026-11-09 against 8.1.0: babel-transform.ts fails type-check (8 ships its own types, with no `TransformOptions` export, so @types/babel__core 7 no longer applies; the returned map no longer assigns to vite's transform result), and the pass passes plugin-react 5.2's generator options (importAttributesKeyword, decoratorsBeforeExport), which 8 removes, so the byte-identical guarantee `scripts/babel-equivalence.ts` checks must be redone. babel-plugin-react-compiler 1.0.0 (latest) still depends on @babel/types ^7. Lift with that migration, once the React Compiler is checked on Babel 8.
